motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Short transitions for focus, hover and drag states.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid #201d1d; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 15px; background: #201d1d; color: #fdfcfc; font: 500 13px/1.35 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #302c2c; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0056b3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions for profile and resource handling.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid #646262; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 15px; background: #fdfcfc; color: #201d1d; font: 500 13px/1.35 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #f8f7f7; border-color: #201d1d; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0056b3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Profile and document controls share the same surface and boundary.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" value="Название работы" aria-label="Название работы">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid #646262; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; background: #f8f7f7; color: #201d1d; font: 400 13px/1.4 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #0056b3; outline: 2px solid #0056b3; outline-offset: 2px; background: #fdfcfc; }

components.name: Workflow Navigation
components.description: Links to the four actual stages of document preparation.
components.css: .ds-workflow { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(15,0,0,.12); } .ds-workflow a { min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #646262; font: 500 12px/1.55 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; text-decoration: none; } .ds-workflow a:hover, .ds-workflow a:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: #201d1d; color: #201d1d; }

components.name: File Dropzone
components.description: A square, dashed target with visible accepted file types.
components.css: .ds-dropzone { display: grid; min-height: 148px; justify-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px dashed #646262; border-radius: 4px; padding: 18px; background: #f8f7f7; color: #201d1d; font: 400 14px/1.55 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-dropzone:hover { border-color: #0056b3; background: #f2f7ff; }

narrative.overview: A task-focused Markdown to DOCX workspace adapted from the user-provided OpenCode system. Warm cream, ink, monospaced type and hairline rules remain; marketing-only TUI imagery and wordmark are omitted.
keyCharacteristics: One monospaced type family across the interface.
Warm cream canvas with near-black ink.
Real four-step document route using bracketed labels.

rules.name: One Type Rule
rules.body: Use the same monospaced font stack for headings, controls, status and body copy.

rules.name: Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use thin rules and tonal surfaces instead of shadows.

dos: Do use accent blue only for links, focus and active guidance.
Do use semantic colors only for success, warning and error states.
donts: Don't use a landing-page hero, decorative gradients or drop shadows.
Don't mix icon families or use serif display type.
